articles.title: US trade deficit surges amid artificial intelligence spending boom
articles.description: Imbalance soars to $77.6bn in May as imports outpaced exports, driven by pharmaceuticals and semiconductors.

articles.title: Amazon raising at least $25 billion in bond sale, won't issue more debt in 2026
articles.description: It marks Amazon's latest debt raise as it looks to buttress its massive investments in artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Ex-Syrian intelligence chief found guilty of torture and sexual abuse by Austrian court
articles.description: Two former Syrian officials went on trial in Vienna, Austria, accused of crimes against opponents of former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad
